cases.title: Initiate drag event and capture product title and price
cases.description: Verify that dragging a product item (li element with draggable='true') initiates a drag event and successfully captures the product's title and price for transfer.

cases.title: Drag and drop product item into drop area
cases.description: Verify that the system allows users to drag and drop product items (e.g., data-testid='product-item-1') into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area') to add them to the cart.

cases.title: Automatic cart display update upon dropping
cases.description: Verify that upon dropping a product, the cart display automatically updates such that the product title appears in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Support adding different and repeated products
cases.description: Verify that the system supports adding both different products and repeated products into the cart via drag and drop.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price
cases.description: Verify that the system calculates the total price by summing the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the appropriate currency symbol, and displays it in the <div id="allMoney"> element.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases accurately cover the requirements provided, properly addressing drag initiation, drop interaction, cart display updates, handling of both different and repeated products, and total price calculation with proper formatting.
All requirements and test cases are clear, valid, and fully supported by the provided requirement descriptions. No blockers or missing scenario types identified.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1 describes multiple distinct behaviors including initiating a drag event, and capturing product title and price. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-3 describes multiple distinct behaviors including dragging and dropping product items into a designated drop area, updating the cart display for title in .box2, unit price in .box3, quantity in .box1, and supporting different/repeated products. Requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-5 describes multiple distinct behaviors including summing prices of all products, formatting the total to two decimal places with the currency symbol, and displaying the total in <div id="allMoney">.
